integrity.reverifyHint: Each event carries seq · hash · prev_hash so a reader can re-verify the link offline.

consent.notAuthorizedHint: Registering is not consent — a run is blocked until a target is authorized.

hash.hint: A one-way fingerprint — never a payload (minimal data).

notices.truncatedHint: This aggregate reached the scan ceiling — it is partial, not an exact total.
notices.selfAudited: Privileged read — recorded in the audit ledger.
notices.seamBody: Declared contract — the {{what}} is not wired to the backend yet, so this shows the declared shape, not live data.
notices.minimalData: Aggregates and metadata only — no prompts, outputs or secrets.
notices.listTruncatedHint: The engine returned one page, not the whole set. The total CANNOT be inferred from the rows loaded, and rows that are not shown may exist.

disclaimers.report: Technical control-status mapping derived from observed platform evidence. NOT a certification and NOT legal advice.

gate.approvedHint: Governance approved this plan — execute to proceed.
gate.rejectedHint: Governance rejected this plan — re-request with a fresh plan.
gate.expiredHint: The approval expired — re-plan and request again.
gate.no_gateHint: No approval gate is configured — the action cannot proceed.
gate.not_requiredHint: No approval is required for this action.
gate.displayNotice: Gate status is a reported decision shown here only. Authorization is enforced server-side; the console never grants access from this value.
